full_details: Morning prayer at St Helen's. Master Thwaite kept to three heads. A man at the porch asked Gillis where he was born, and got Norwich. Sir John passed his own door and did not speak. No order has shut the playhouse. You came home. The loaf is still a full thumb short of the notch. Gib stayed on the Golding, and Brooke stayed on the shelf. About nine a sound began to the south-east that was not bells. A boy in the close cried a thousand on Tower Hill. You were not there and saw none of it. Mistress Ansell barred the street door with you, and both of you made it sound usual. Gillis went up to the garret without a word. Alse slept in her mistress's chamber. You barred your own door. The one candle stood on the boards behind the bed. She asked after that light before you went up, and it was yours, the only light in the house. You whispered the dark, and you let it go by.
one_sentence: You heard Norwich at the porch, wrote a short page, and after nine helped bar the street door.
title: Heard St Peter's and barred the street door
